title: ProjectionResultV1
description: The generic envelope every projection travels in. It carries the citation (canonical_revision_id), the label (projection_kind), the deterministic digest, and one typed payload. projection_kind and payload are coupled: a tab envelope must carry a TabProjectionV1 and a notation envelope a NotationProjectionV1, so a schema-only consumer cannot accept a mislabelled result. The remaining invariant -- that the envelope and payload cite the same revision -- stays in Python, since JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values.

canonical_revision_id.description: The revision this result was derived from. Excluded from the digest's inputs along with projection_id, so two identical renderings of one revision digest identically however they are labelled.

payload.description: The typed projection. Which shape is required is decided by projection_kind, in the allOf below.

digest.description: sha256 over the payload, excluding the digest itself and projection_id.

allOf.description: A tab envelope must carry a TabProjectionV1. Expressed as if/then rather than a oneOf on payload alone: a union would accept a notation payload under projection_kind tab, since one branch would still match, and a schema-only consumer would have no way to notice.
A notation envelope must carry a NotationProjectionV1.
